summary:
Successfully reproduced the core contributions of SCoRe (Training Language Models to Self-Correct via RL):

**Algorithm Implementation:**
- Two-stage multi-turn RL: Stage I (attempt decoupling with KL constraint on first turn, Eq. 3) and Stage II (joint optimization with progress bonus reward shaping, Eq. 4)
- REINFORCE policy gradient with KL-divergence penalty against frozen reference model (Ahmadian et al., 2024)
- Progress bonus: b(y₂|y₁) = α·(r̂(y₂) - r̂(y₁)) with α=10.0

**Baselines (Section 4):**
- STaR: iterative SFT on filtered successful correction traces (D_STaR and D_STaR^+ variants)
- Pair-SFT: synthetic incorrect→correct pairing approach

**Evaluation (Section 3 & 6):**
- All five metrics: Accuracy@t1, Accuracy@t2, Δ(t1,t2), Δ(i→c), Δ(c→i)
- Edit distance ratio analysis for behavior collapse detection
- Self-consistency evaluation for inference-time scaling (Section 6.2)

**Infrastructure:**
- Prompt templates from Appendix C (MATH zero-shot CoT, MATH correction, MBPP 3-shot, HumanEval zero-shot)
- Hyperparameters from Table 5 (MATH: 3000 steps, batch 512, lr 5e-6, β₂=0.1; MBPP: 1500 steps, batch 128, lr 1e-5, β₂=0.25)
- Ablation studies support (w/o Stage I, w/o reward shaping, single-turn, STaR Stage II)
- MATH, MBPP, HumanEval dataset loaders with train/test splits per Section 6
- Model-agnostic design supporting any HuggingFace causal LM
